title_zh: 把公共路径诉求改成可回答的问题

scenario.label_zh: 明确公共路径诉求的提问范围
scenario.goal_zh: 区分候选人与议会的权限，并拟定关于禁令审查及居民参与的具体问题

context_zh: 虚构城镇的居民准备在公开问答会上询问自行车禁令，先澄清候选人的权限。
author: author-phase05-a

sentences.speaker: Farah
sentences.text: Our campaign asks for the riverside path to reopen to bicycles. What should we ask at tonight's meeting?

sentences.speaker: Colin
sentences.text: The candidate may support us, but she does not have the authority to change the rule by herself.

sentences.speaker: Colin
sentences.text: In this town, the full council decides whether to keep the ban.

sentences.speaker: Farah
sentences.text: Then asking her to reopen the path tomorrow would not get us a useful answer.

sentences.speaker: Colin
sentences.text: Right. Ask whether she would request a review and what evidence she would want to see.

sentences.speaker: Farah
sentences.text: I will use that question and bring the count of people using the path.

sentences.speaker: Colin
sentences.text: Good. We should also ask how residents can take part in any review.

targets.sense_zh: 为某一目标进行的活动
